fields.description: An existing room of this site. Beds Only adds beds to rooms that already exist.
fields.label: Room

fields.description: Single gives one bed per unit. Bunk gives one bed per level of each bunk. Single + Bunk mixes both in one room.
fields.label: Bed Setup

fields.description: Single: number of beds in this room. Bunk or Single + Bunk: number of bunk beds in this room, each giving one bed per Bunk Level.
fields.label: Beds / Bunks

fields.description: Single beds in this room, numbered after the bunks. For example 2 bunks and 1 single give B01-L, B01-U, B02-L, B02-U and B03.
fields.label: Single Beds

fields.description: 2 gives each bunk a Lower and an Upper bed (B01-L, B01-U). 3 adds a Middle bed (B01-L, B01-M, B01-U).
fields.label: Bunk Levels

fields.description: Beds actually added: one per level of each bunk, plus the single beds.
fields.label: = Beds

fields.description: First bed number, for example 3 gives B03, B04 and so on.
fields.label: Start No.
